title: Gutter Cleaning Checklist
subtitle: Residential Gutter Cleaning: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Gutter Cleaning Checklist covers gutter run, outlet, downspout, discharge, roof edge, and collected debris. The gutter service coordinator records Residential Gutter Cleaning criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Gutter Cleaning Checklist keeps Residential Gutter Cleaning exceptions visible until the gutter service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Gutter Cleaning Checklist at residence perimeter, roof edge, ladder position, discharge point, and protected landscaping. Document gutter run, outlet, downspout, discharge, roof edge, and collected debris identity before Residential Gutter Cleaning begins. Compare gutter run, outlet, downspout, discharge, roof edge, and collected debris findings with stated Residential Gutter Cleaning criteria; route unresolved Residential Gutter Cleaning issues to exterior service supervisor. For Gutter Cleaning Checklist, confirm requirements for Residential Gutter Cleaning. Ask exterior service supervisor to review Residential Gutter Cleaning conditions beyond the gutter service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Residential Gutter Cleaning, identify responsible parties, residence perimeter, roof edge, ladder position, discharge point, and protected landscaping, and the linked gutter run, outlet, downspout, discharge, roof edge, and collected debris source.

fields.label: Access method, roof height, weather, and discharge expectation

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Gutter Cleaning facts for gutter run, outlet, downspout, discharge, roof edge, and collected debris; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Residential Gutter Cleaning inspection checks
items: Gutter pitch, joint, hanger, seam, and visible damage
Discharge location, erosion, and foundation proximity
Roof-edge, fascia, soffit, and adjacent condition

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Residential Gutter Cleaning finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Gutter Service Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Unsafe ladder, edge, weather, or power-line proximity
Loose gutter or damaged fascia cannot support work
Downspout blockage requires disassembly beyond scope
Water discharge creates property or erosion concern
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Gutter Cleaning when access, edge, weather, electrical proximity, unstable attachment, or unsafe discharge remains. Retain the available Residential Gutter Cleaning proof and route unresolved gutter run, outlet, downspout, discharge, roof edge, and collected debris scope to gutter service coordinator.
